description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Associate Analyst – Supply Chain Data, Integration & Analytics About Thermo Fisher Scientific At Thermo Fisher Scientific, everything we do begins with our Mission — to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. As a global leader in serving science, we deliver innovative solutions that impact healthcare, life sciences, and research worldwide. Our values — Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement — shape how we work together. Role Overview We are looking for a curious, analytical graduate who enjoys working with data and technology to join our Supply Chain IT team as an Associate Analyst for supply chain data, integration, testing, and analytics . Our supply chain runs on connected systems — ERP (SAP, Oracle JD Edwards, Oracle Cloud SCM), planning (Kinaxis), and warehouse management (Manhattan). Every forecast, order, and shipment depends on data moving accurately between these systems . When an interface fails or master data is wrong, plans break and products are delayed. In this role, you will help make sure our data is correct, connected, tested, and turned into insight . You will learn how data flows end-to-end — from item master, to plan, to shipment — and progressively take ownership of interface monitoring, data quality checks, system testing, and reporting alongside experienced data engineers and application specialists. No prior work experience is expected — we will train you. What we need from you are strong fundamentals in SQL and data, logical thinking, attention to detail, and the curiosity to understand how the business actually uses the data. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who wants to build a career at the intersection of data engineering, integration, quality assurance, analytics, and AI in supply chain . How You Will Grow in Your First Year Months 0–3 | Learn: Structured onboarding on supply chain processes and our system landscape; SQL, data model, and integration fundamentals; shadow interface monitoring and testing cycles. Months 3–6 | Contribute: Run data quality and reconciliation checks; execute test scripts and log defects; build or enhance simple reports and dashboards. Months 6–12 | Own: Independently monitor defined interfaces and resolve routine data issues; automate at least one recurring check or report; contribute to test planning for a release or project. Key Responsibilities Monitor data interfaces and integration jobs between ERP, Kinaxis, WMS, and other applications; identify failures, analyze errors, and coordinate resolution. Write SQL queries to validate, reconcile, and troubleshoot data across source and target systems. Perform data quality checks on master data (items, bills of material, lead times, sourcing rules, locations) and transactional data; highlight gaps and help drive corrections with data owners. Help document data flows, field mappings, transformation rules, and interface specifications. Prepare and execute test cases for system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT); log, track, and retest defects. Prepare test documentation and evidence in line with computer system validation (CSV) and GxP requirements. Build and maintain reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI) that track supply chain KPIs, data quality, and interface health. Automate repetitive checks, reconciliations, and reports using SQL, Python, or low-code tools. Assist data engineers with data preparation and pipelines on our cloud data platforms. Work with functional analysts, developers, planners, and business users to understand requirements and explain data issues in plain language. Explore how analytics, machine learning, and AI can detect data anomalies, predict failures, and improve supply chain decisions. What We Look For Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline. Solid fundamentals in SQL and relational databases (joins, keys, aggregations) through coursework or projects. Basic programming ability in Python or a similar language. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with high attention to detail. Good Excel skills for data analysis. Conceptual understanding of how data moves between systems — files, APIs, or databases. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a data problem to a non-technical user. Interest in learning how supply chains and enterprise business applications work. Good to have Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or another BI/reporting tool. Academic or project exposure to cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks) or ETL/integration tools. Understanding of software testing concepts — test cases, defect lifecycle, regression testing. Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON/XML, or flat-file data formats. Coursework in supply chain, operations, or ERP concepts. Exposure to Generative AI / LLMs, or machine learning projects such as forecasting or anomaly detection. Familiarity with Agile / Scrum and tools such as Jira or Git. An internship, hackathon, or live project involving data analysis, data engineering, or testing. Why join us Competitive salary with annual performance-based bonus. Comprehensive medical insurance covering you, your spouse, children, and dependent parents. Structured onboarding, a 12-month learning plan, and a dedicated mentor for your first six months. Sponsored certifications in data, analytics, and cloud technologies relevant to your role. End-to-end exposure to a global enterprise system landscape — SAP, Oracle, Kinaxis, and Manhattan WMS. Clear career progression into Data Engineer, Integration Specialist, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, or QA/Test Lead tracks. Access to Thermo Fisher's global learning platform. Hybrid working model with flexible hours. Employee wellness programs, on-campus recreational facilities, and mental health support. Paid time off, parental leave, and company-paid holidays. Opportunity to work with global teams across the US, Europe, and APAC.

title: Industrial Trainee
description: About The Company We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle. "The spending youth, especially the millennials & Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say. RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and appliances. Currently, we have 100,000+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 12-14 months. The current market size (as per a recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025. With 700+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US and UK. We are also profitable at monthly PAT since Oct 2021. Recent Media Coverage: The Economic Times , Feb 24 Role: Industrial Trainee Location: Bangalore Job Overview The Industrial Trainee will be part of the Finance team and will gain structured exposure across Financial Planning , Treasury, Financial Modelling, and Debt.Management. The role is designed to provide practical experience aligned with ICAI training requirements. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a strong understanding of customer needs, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Role Responsibilities Assist in preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial projections Support development of financial models for business planning Perform variance analysis and track key financial metrics Assist in cash flow management and working capital monitoring Prepare financial data and reports for investors Support in preparation of management reports and presentations Key Requirements Assist in preparation of budgets, forecasts, and financial projections Support development of financial models for business planning Perform variance analysis and track key financial metrics Assist in cash flow management and working capital monitoring Prepare financial data and reports for investors Support in preparation of management reports and presentations Preferred Qualifications CA Intermediate cleared (Both Groups) Eligible for Industrial Training as per ICAI norms Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Proficiency in MS Excel (Advanced level preferred) Candidates available for immediate joining preferred Note: This is a paid internship.Skills: financial models,investors,management,capital monitoring

title: Intern, Analytics
description: Role Title: Intern, Analytics (L07) Company Overview With roots in consumer finance that trace back to 1932, Synchrony is a leader in consumer credit and promotional financing, providing a range of products for a diverse group of national and regional retailers in USA, including main street mainstays, local merchants, manufacturers, buying groups, industry associations, and healthcare providers. Synchrony International Services Pvt. Ltd. is recognized as #2 among India's Best Companies to Work. Each year, Great Place to Work® identifies India's 100 Best Companies to Work For (with employee strength more than 500) through an objective and rigorous workplace culture assessment process. https://www.greatplacetowork.in/ Organizational Overview Our Analytics team comprises of data analysts who focus on improving customer/product/digital/ journey experience etc. and growth by providing full stack descriptive to prescriptive analytics via cutting edge technologies to support business objectives. Role Summary/Purpose Analyst, Analytics (individual contributor) role is a part of India Analytics Hub (IAH). The role will include understanding the request of the business, Extract, transform, validate and visualize large data to address project delivery enabling Synchrony’s growth and profitability. The model candidate must be passionate about data & analytics , knows the story and keen on learning new technologies. This position is remote, where you have the option to work from home Key Responsibilities Leverage Data and Analytical tools to create and track metrics which reflect state of the business Triangulate and analyze data from multiple sources to draw insights and make recommendations to fulfil business/project objectives Adherence to timely delivery, accuracy and documentation in line with Audit Procedures Required Skills/Knowledge Academic knowledge of SQL/SAS/Open Source concepts, ability to write and execute queries Basic Understanding of Core Concepts/ Metrics in Retail Finance Ability to articulate analysis outcomes into findings and recommendations Desired Skills/Knowledge Working Knowledge on SQL/SAS/Python to perform data manipulation Eligibility Criteria Currently pursuing the final year of BTech/MSc/MTech/MBA/MA in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or related discipline. Work Timings This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details. Location : During the internship period, students are permitted to work from their university location. However, upon successful conversion to a full-time role, they will be required to relocate to one of Synchrony’s designated Regional Engagement Hub (REH) locations: Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. While they may work from home or from a local workspace within these hubs, residency in one of these approved regions is required. In addition, regular or occasional travel to the Hyderabad hub is a mandatory condition of employment Job Family Group Data Analytics

title: Intern – Learning & Development /Data Anaytics
description: About CAST Software Businesses move faster using CAST technology to understand, improve, and transform their software. Through semantic analysis of source code, CAST produces 3D maps and dashboards to navigate inside individual applications and across entire portfolios. This intelligence empowers executives and technology leaders to steer, speed, and report on initiatives such as technical debt, GenAI, modernization, and cloud. As the pioneer of the software intelligence field, CAST is trusted by the world’s leading companies and governments, their consultancies and cloud providers. See it all at castsoftware.com. Role Overview We are looking for a motivated and analytical engineering graduate to support Learning & Development (L&D) operations, Learning Management System (LMS) administration and training initiatives within CAST. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in Data Analytics, reporting, process automation and learning technologies. In addition to managing day-to-day LMS operations, the candidate will contribute to developing L&D metrics, monitoring training progress, identifying improvement opportunities and providing actionable insights to management. This role offers an opportunity to work with global teams and stakeholders while gaining exposure to enterprise learning platforms, data analytics and business operations. Key Responsibilities Manage and administer the eLearning platform (360Learning), including user access, course assignments, learning plans and content management. Support employees with CAST University login, navigation and course access. Manage LMS requests received from internal teams and global customers, coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Provide basic JIRA training and guidance workflow for CAST University project to employees when required. Monitor LMS usage, course completion and employee learning progress. Support the rollout of learning initiatives and internal training programs. Collect, consolidate and analyze learning data from different tools and platforms. Develop regular L&D dashboards and reports covering enrollment, course completion, learning hours, progress and training effectiveness. Contribute to the development of meaningful L&D KPIs and performance metrics. Identify learning gaps, trends and opportunities for improvement through data analysis. Present actionable insights and recommendations to management and senior stakeholders. Explore opportunities to automate recurring reports and reduce manual effort. Coordinate with internal teams, sales representatives and global stakeholders for LMS and training-related requests. Provide timely support and resolution for learning platform queries. Candidate Prerequisites & Skills Educational Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech). Candidates from reputed engineering institutions with a background or exposure to Data Analytics will be preferred. Consistent academic performance with a minimum of 70% in 10th, 12th and graduation. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in MS Office, particularly: MS Excel – Advanced Excel, Pivot Tables, Lookups, Macros and data analysis. MS PowerPoint – Management presentations and dashboards. MS Word – Documentation and reporting. Basic understanding of Data Analytics and visualization tools. Basic knowledge of automation and reporting tools will be an added advantage. Soft Skills : Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to communicate effectively with senior management and global stakeholders. Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take ownership. Ability to multitask and work independently. Preferred Candidate Profile A bright, self-driven engineering graduate with an analytical mindset, good communication skills and an interest in learning technologies and business operations. The candidate should be comfortable working with data, generating meaningful insights, managing multiple responsibilities and interacting with stakeholders across different geographies. The expectation is to develop this role beyond routine LMS administration, making it a combination of L&D Operations, Data Analytics, Reporting and Process Improvement.

title: Data Scientist
description: Company Description Beige Bananas is one of the world’s fastest-growing pure play AI consulting firms, specializing in hyper-custom AI products for rapidly evolving business use cases. Leveraging decreasing computation costs and increasing computational power, the company builds tailored AI solutions that align closely with client objectives. Beige Bananas maintains an outcome-driven mindset, helping organizations accelerate value realization from their analytics and AI investments. The firm serves Fortune 500 companies across Retail, CPG, and Media sectors, building long-term partnerships based on trust and measurable results. Role Description As a Data Scientist Intern at Beige Bananas, you will collaborate with senior data scientists and consultants to design, test, and refine data-driven solutions for client projects. On a day-to-day basis, you will clean and prepare datasets, conduct exploratory data analysis, build and evaluate statistical and machine learning models, and create clear visualizations and reports to communicate findings. You will contribute to proof-of-concept AI products, document methodologies, and support the translation of business questions into analytical approaches. This is a remote internship role, requiring proactive communication, reliable time management, and the ability to work effectively within distributed teams. Qualifications Strong foundation in Data Science and Statistics, with the ability to apply quantitative methods to real-world problems. Proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Analysis, including cleaning, transforming, and interpreting complex datasets. Experience with Data Visualization, using tools or libraries (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn) to present insights clearly. Hands-on skills in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and familiarity with SQL. Knowledge of basic machine learning concepts and frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or similar) is beneficial. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related discipline. Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, structured, and concise manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Comfort working in a remote environment, with strong organizational skills and a collaborative, outcome-focused mindset.

title: Intern
description: About REVERSE REVERSE is a Bengaluru-based cleantech startup building India’s packaging reuse infrastructure. Most packaging in India is used once and discarded, even when it can be reused multiple times. We work with brands to enable circularity for their packaging by building the systems, technology and supply chain required to collect, sort, sanitise and return packaging back into use. Our network currently includes housing societies, restaurants, hotels, cafés, collection partners and brands across Bengaluru. Today, REVERSE has: Enabled the reuse of 4.7M+ packaging units Worked with 15+ brands Built 355+ return points across Bengaluru and Goa Been supported by leading startup and innovation ecosystems, including IIM Bangalore and IIM Ahmedabad. We are now hiring interns across multiple functions to work closely with our team and help us scale packaging reuse. Open Internship Role: 1. Brand Strategy & GTM Intern (You will work on how REVERSE is positioned, communicated, and taken to market.) Key responsibilities include: Support brand strategy, positioning and communication Plan and execute growth and behaviour-change campaigns Conduct customer and market research Interact with residents, businesses, brands and channel partners Support go-to-market plans for housing societies, cafés, restaurants and other channels Experiment with messaging, acquisition channels and engagement strategies Track campaign and customer conversion data Support partnerships and new market initiatives This role is ideal for someone interested in branding, marketing, consumer behaviour, strategy, growth and entrepreneurship. 2. Supply Chain Intern (You will work closely with our operations team to understand and improve the end-to-end supply chain behind packaging reuse.) Key responsibilities include: Support onboarding and management of collection and channel partners Analyse logistics routes, costs, and operational efficiency Help improve collection, segregation, inventory and dispatch processes Work on lean operations and process improvement initiatives Maintain and analyse operational and supply chain data Support implementation of SCM and internal tracking tools Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements Work with field teams, warehouses and partners to improve execution This role is ideal for someone interested in supply chain, operations, logistics, analytics and process optimisation. 3. Tech Intern - Computer Vision / Robotics / Mechanical / Computer Science (You will work with our technology and engineering team on products that enable packaging reuse at scale.) Depending on your background, you may work on: Computer vision models for packaging and SKU identification Image processing and AI-based sorting systems Robotics and automation for packaging segregation Mechanical design and integration of sorting systems Sensors, actuators, and conveyor-based automation ERP, inventory and operations management modules Backend, frontend and data management systems Testing, deployment and performance improvement of live systems This role is ideal for students from Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics or related disciplines who enjoy building and testing real-world systems. What You Can Expect At REVERSE, interns are expected to take ownership of real projects rather than work only on support tasks. You will have the opportunity to: Work directly with the founding and core team Solve real operational and technology problems See your work deployed in the field Work across business, technology, and sustainability Learn how an early-stage cleantech company scales Take ownership of projects with measurable outcomes Internship Details Location: Bengaluru Work model: Hybrid Duration: 6 months Internship: Paid PPO: Opportunity available for high-performing interns We are looking for people who are curious, hands-on, comfortable taking ownership, and excited about building systems that create measurable environmental impact. If you want to work on a problem where technology, business, operations, and sustainability come together, we would love to hear from you.

title: Procurement Intern
description: Procurement Intern | Snabbit About Snabbit Snabbit is India’s first Quick-Service App delivering home services in just 10 minutes through a hyperlocal network of trained and verified professionals. Backed by Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and Lightspeed, Snabbit is redefining the home services space by combining speed, quality, and trust. Founded by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit aims to make home services as seamless and instant as ordering groceries. About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Intern to support the procurement team across data management, reporting, process documentation, and vendor coordination. You will work closely with the procurement team to maintain vendor databases, manage procurement MIS reports, support vendor onboarding, streamline documentation, and gain hands-on exposure to the Purchase Requisition (PR) to Purchase Order (PO) process. Key Responsibilities Maintain, clean, and regularly update the Vendor Master Database, item catalogs, and historical pricing logs. Ensure data accuracy across procurement spreadsheets and internal tools by removing duplicates and standardising entry formats. Collect, verify, and maintain vendor onboarding documents, including GST certificates, PAN, MSME status, bank details, and compliance forms. Assist in compiling, updating, and automating daily, weekly, and monthly procurement MIS reports. Track key procurement metrics such as PO turnaround time, open versus closed requisitions, vendor lead times, and cost-saving logs. Build basic dashboards and visual summaries using Excel/Google Sheets to monitor departmental spend and operational bottlenecks. Support the documentation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for routine workflows, including PR-to-PO cycles and vendor onboarding. Help design and standardise internal request templates, approval checklists, and tracking sheets to streamline purchasing requests. Assist in identifying repetitive manual tasks and recommending simple workflow improvements. Support buyers in floating Requests for Quotations (RFQs) and preparing price comparison sheets. Follow up with vendors on order acknowledgments, delivery schedules, and invoice/GRN (Goods Receipt Note) discrepancies. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Finance, Warehouse/Operations, and requesting departments, to ensure smooth documentation flow. What We're Looking For Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets , including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF statements, data cleaning, and basic charting.
